title: Virtual Compute: evt request
content:
## Formal basis

Virtual Compute — Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request. Preserve the exact external reference and the narrowest original source reference. Set request notice time and event occurrence time to the frozen clock and status pending on filing; cancellation is a new request event with status cancelled linked to the original request. An unsupported channel is refused. A repeated identical request reference returns the existing event. Filing a request never confirms a system approval or changes an accounting balance.

## Basis Q&A

**What is the judgement for evt request?**

Only the customer may file or cancel an authorization, claim or disposal request.
